items.title: Barclays downgrades Gartner, flags AI risks for information services stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays downgraded Gartner (NYSE: IT) to Underweight while raising its price target to $185 from $150 in a note on Friday, as the bank remains cautious on information services companies whose business models could be disrupted by AI.

items.title: How Gartner Recognition Will Impact Workday Stock Ahead Of Earnings
items.summary: Workday has been recognized in the past week as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for the fifth straight year and is the only vendor labeled a Customers' Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for the same category. This combination of repeated Gartner leadership and strong customer feedback highlights that Workday’s unified HR and finance platform is gaining validation for real world deployments where organizations want AI driven automation...

items.title: Workday (WDAY), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
items.summary: Recognition from Gartner as a Leader and Customers' Choice in cloud ERP put fresh attention on Workday (WDAY). This industry endorsement gives investors another reference point as they assess the software group's valuation. The Gartner recognition comes during a mixed period for Workday. The share price is at US$201.84 after a 90 day share price return of 18.56%, which contrasts with a 1 year total shareholder return decline of 13.04%. items.title: Gartner (IT) Upgraded to Buy: Here's What You Should Know
items.summary: Gartner (IT) might move higher on growing optimism about its earnings prospects, which is reflected by its upgrade to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

items.title: Gartner: Truist says growth rebound looks further away, cuts rating
items.summary: Investing.com -- Truist downgraded Gartner to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $210 from $235 in a note Wednesday, telling clients that a recovery in the research company’s key growth metric now looks less likely in the near term.
